page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.small is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.c1 server family. It is configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores, operating with 1.0 thread per core. The instance features 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 1.0 GB per core. It runs on the KVM hypervisor.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage must be network-attached. There are no integrated GPUs, and the configuration does not bundle any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With a 1:1 ratio of vCPUs to memory, the ecs.c1.small is structured for compute-heavy workloads that do not require large memory footprints. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention. This resource density makes it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for pure CPU-bound tasks, such as batch processing, lightweight web serving, and basic computational modeling, where memory overhead is minimal.
